manual_overrides.source_note: Active GEODNET devices per DePIN Scan, reference_date 2026-09-15 — the figure already recorded in config.py as GEODNET.supply_units_reference, now seeded as the metric so archetype 2 has a number rather than a permanent gap. THIRD-PARTY AGGREGATOR, NOT GEODNET: the primary would be GEODNET's own console map ('All Miners' toggle), which has no fetchable endpoint on file. Dated to DePIN Scan's reference date, NOT to the run. TWO OTHER COUNTS ARE ON FILE AND DELIBERATELY NOT RECONCILED TO THIS ONE — GEODNET's own '21,000+ miners across 160-170 countries' (2026-07) and Messari's 19,840 active satellite miners (2025-Q3) — because they count different things over different periods. This also unblocks nothing on its own: network issuance needs a miner count AND the per-miner schedule's uptime, band and zone multipliers, none of which are on file.

CIRCULATING SUPPLY AS BLOCKWORKS PUBLISHES IT (app.blockworks.com/projects/geodnet) — a THIRD PARTY, not GEODNET (Jake, 2026-10-07: 'Jake's 462M is from Blockworks'); equal to CoinGecko's fixed 462,360,759 and static while mining releases ~122K GEOD/day. GEODNET publishes no circulating figure of its own. In use only until the Solana side is resolved; then our on-chain set (wallets GEODNET's docs name) becomes primary and this a labelled static cross-check. The on-chain set (~516M) is the cross-check meanwhile (Credibility in_circ, Review Queue). The un-netted Solana-burn adjustment is NOT applied to it. Monthly manual row: AMBER after 45 days. Was stored 2026-10-07 under circulating_supply_first_party (relabelled the same day). Entered by Claude Code, pending Jake's review.

gap_report.reason: ANSWERED, NOT OPEN — Decided 2026-09-28 (Jake): pool_release_tokens (the measured mining-wallet outflow) is GEODNET's supply-side route; per-miner issuance is not derivable from any supply figure, so this column stays n/a. the supply-delta derivation is SUPPRESSED for this project: issuance is schedule-based and PER-MINER — f(miner count, uptime, data quality, band type, zone multipliers) — not a function of the supply delta. The derivation was returning a plausible-looking zero, and a false zero is worse than a gap: it renders as a measured figure, feeds the burn/issuance ratio as a denominator, and carries a confidence band it has not earned.
gap_report.suggestion: supply_units (miner count) is sourced, at which point network issuance can be modelled from per_miner_reward_schedule — or, better, read directly from the mining distribution wallet's outflow (see contracts).
